checks.name: Initial render, complete tree, audio opt-in
Keyboard orbit and zoom
checks.evidence: ArrowRight, + and − change the actual renderer state while paused.

checks.name: Pointer drag
checks.evidence: The camera rotated after an actual pointer drag.

checks.name: All palettes and both render modes
checks.evidence: State and aria-pressed agree with selected controls.

checks.name: Audio opt-in and off
checks.evidence: A real button click starts AudioContext; a second click disables the score.

checks.name: Personal letter, held heart, Escape and focus return
checks.evidence: The requested apology, thanks and wish for Si-eun’s happiness appear in a native dialog.

checks.name: Empty, whitespace and saved wish
checks.evidence: Empty/blank input is rejected; valid text persists and changes the tree into a heart.

checks.name: Wish persistence and deletion
checks.evidence: Reload restores the wish; the visible delete button removes the storage key.

checks.name: Growth and burst recovery
checks.evidence: The tree grows again, bursts, and returns to its original structure.

checks.name: Two-finger pinch
checks.evidence: Real CDP touch events zoom the mobile tree.

checks.name: Reduced motion
checks.evidence: Initial tree stays static; the explicit letter action shows a static heart without a transition.

checks.name: Storage unavailable and literal input
checks.evidence: Denied storage gives honest feedback; HTML-like wish text never becomes markup.

checks.name: WebGL context loss and restoration
checks.evidence: The recovery notice appears on loss; GPU resources are recreated and the notice clears.

checks.name: WebGL unavailable
checks.evidence: A clear recovery panel and retry button replace the loading indicator.

checks.name: No uncaught errors or external requests
checks.evidence: All fonts, scripts and styles are served locally.
